422.description: Invalid UUID, out-of-range identifier, malformed body, unknown input field or invalid buyer_ref. detail may be a validation list or an object with code.

post.description: Uses the game code policy. Observe cooldown.retry_after before another request. Send an optional UUID Idempotency-Key to make retries safe. Reuse the key, issue_id and buyer_ref after a timeout. A committed key returns the original unexpired code with replayed=true and no new consumption. An expired code returns 409 guard_code_expired; explicitly use a new key for a new code. Requests without a key retain legacy behavior. Codes are encrypted at rest. Rules are also returned in account.guard_rules and by GET guard-rules. Code count and slot windows are rolling, not calendar days. The game settings govern the current limits.
